capabilities: Strip notification counts from pasted YouTube link titles
Convert timestamped YouTube URLs into readable Markdown links showing the time
Link bare time notations to the note's source video at that moment
Strip or defuse hashtags in YouTube link titles
disambiguation: Not a YouTube embed or video player; it only rewrites link text and URLs already in notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pre-release builds can be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: a companion to the official Obsidian Web Clipper
motivation: It was built as a companion to the Obsidian Web Clipper, whose clips leave a video URL in a source property and a transcript full of unlinked time notations.
problem: YouTube links pasted into notes carry notification counts, unreadable timestamp URLs, and hashtags that seed unwanted tags, while bare time notations like 2:34 stay unlinked.

relations.evidence: a companion to the official Obsidian Web Clipper, which captures a video's URL

summary: Cleans YouTube links and timestamps: strips notification counts and hashtags, makes timestamp URLs readable, and links bare time notations to the source video.
